description: Add a website chat: name (what visitors see), color (#rrggbb), greeting (the first line inside the chat once it is open), cta (what the closed bubble says on the page, up to 90 characters, to get it opened at all; empty uses the tagline of the brand whose host it is, and nothing at all on a host that is no brand's, where the page can say it itself with data-cta on the snippet; never shown inside MakeHybrid), sites (host names that may show it, *.example.com for subdomains; none means any), ask_email (off, optional, required), room_id and agent_id. The answer's snippet goes before </body> on every page. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /webchat/v1/widgets, group webchat.
